claims.text: Kaiord

Kaiord gathers an athlete's training and health data from the platforms where it is scattered. It comes as two products: the Kaiord App, a browser application to plan, build and send workouts, with no account; and the Kaiord SDK, TypeScript libraries, a CLI and an MCP server for the FIT, TCX, ZWO and Garmin Connect workout formats. MIT licensed, by Pablo Albaladejo.

claims.text: Key facts:

The Kaiord App is free, needs no sign-up, and stores its data in the browser (IndexedDB). Data leaves the device only to destinations the athlete sets up: the AI provider whose key they enter, the platforms they connect through browser extensions, intervals.icu to check the API key they add for it, and their own Google Drive if they turn on sync. Separately, every page loads Umami analytics, which records anonymous page views and product events, never workouts, health data or keys. Kaiord keeps no accounts and stores no user data on its servers.
